name: feedbacks

scripts.test: npm run build:plugin && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web && npm run build:site && npm run build:extension && npm run build:plugin
scripts.build:site: node scripts/prepare-walkthroughs.mjs && npm run site:comparisons:check && vite build --config vite.site.config.ts && node scripts/publish-docs.mjs && vitepress build site-docs && node scripts/export-docs.mjs
scripts.dev:docs: node scripts/prepare-walkthroughs.mjs && node scripts/publish-docs.mjs && vitepress dev site-docs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run check:harness && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run harness:smoke && npm run check:release
scripts.test:postgres: FEEDBACKS_NATIVE_POSTGRES=1 node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=2 tests/cursor-concurrency.test.ts tests/diagnostic-evidence-postgres.test.ts tests/login-throttle-postgres.test.ts tests/oauth-postgres.test.ts
scripts.qa:recording-browser: FEEDBACKS_RECORDING_BROWSER_SMOKE=1 node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/recording-audio-browser.test.ts tests/recording-page-controls-browser.test.ts tests/recording-video-state-browser.test.ts tests/replay-fidelity-browser.test.ts tests/recording-replay-browser.test.ts tests/recording-storage-browser.test.ts tests/recording-viewer-browser.test.ts tests/evidence-viewer-browser.test.ts tests/screenshot-markup-browser.test.ts tests/session-replay-extension-browser.test.ts tests/session-review-browser.test.ts tests/session-review-follow-browser.test.ts tests/session-tail-browser.test.ts tests/video-metadata-browser.test.ts tests/video-review-layout-browser.test.ts tests/capture-send-browser.test.ts
scripts.qa:extension-browser: node scripts/extension-browser-qa.mjs && node scripts/screenshot-editor-qa.mjs && node scripts/session-replay-browser-qa.mjs && node scripts/session-origins-browser-qa.mjs && node scripts/recording-navigation-browser-qa.mjs

description: Visual website feedback with a browser extension, shared review workspace, HTTP API, MCP and CLI.
